dataset_info.notes: mTEDx Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) test split, 340 rows — TEDx-talk read/spontaneous speech with transcripts. Closes the salvage audit's pt-BR gap; facebook/multilingual_librispeech's pt subset was considered but its refs/convert/parquet layout is per-language/split/shard (portuguese/test/0000.parquet) rather than the {subset}/{split}-NNNNN-of-MMMMM.parquet convention runner/audio_io.py's _parquet_files() prefix-matches, so it falls through to grabbing every language/split shard in the repo instead of isolating Portuguese — not registered, see PR notes.
